title: Debiasing Reward Models by Representation Learning with Guarantees

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a QA preference dataset where surface-level agreement (e.g., prepending 'Yes, you are right.') is spuriously correlated with correctness during training, and evaluating the reward model's deviation from an oracle performance and worst-case accuracy across varying levels of distribution shift in the test set.

Inducing spurious correlations between specific text concepts (e.g., shoe 'color' vs. 'size') and sentiment/preference labels in an Amazon Shoe Review dataset, then evaluating the model's robustness to varying correlation levels using worst-case accuracy and the Bias@C metric.
